warning_source: Head of Shin Bet Southern District; Southern Command interagency readiness forum
recipient: Maj. Gen. Yaron Finkelman; senior Southern Command, IDF Operations and Shin Bet officials
warning_summary: Shin Bet South warned that Hamas could execute an opening strike when it judged that useful, while the forum documented degrading Gaza intelligence coverage and a need for warning without the principal secret collection tool.
evidence_update: Accepted to Notion at Medium confidence. Ronen Bergman's Ynet investigation reproduces a contemporaneous 14 Sep 2023 summary of the 3 Sep forum; N12 independently reports the early-Sep Gaza-readiness meeting and its conclusion to raise readiness; the Shin Bet's Mar 2025 internal inquiry independently corroborates the unstable-period/Gaza-readiness chain.
gaps: Underlying 14 Sep summary paper is not publicly released in full; no evidence reviewed shows this specific 3 Sep warning reached a political officeholder or caused a specific force-redeployment decision.

warning_summary: Shin Bet publicly reported that its investigation found Hamas directed the 4 Sep attempt to move C4 explosive and detonators through Kerem Shalom.
evidence_update: Rechecked the official 20 Sep 2023 Shin Bet publication. It establishes Hamas direction of the smuggling attempt but does not itself frame the incident as a broader strategic warning or identify a named senior decision-maker who received such a warning.
gaps: Need evidence of strategic-warning interpretation and delivery to a qualifying senior recipient before acceptance as a distinct warning event.
